title: Horizon payload manifest
description: payload.json: what a Horizon payload contains, the hash of every file, and the program to start. Design and rules: docs/design/centralized-launcher.md. 'entry' must name one of 'files'. The JSON Schema cannot express that, so it is checked by the reader.

schema.description: Manifest format. A reader refuses a higher number; bump it only for an incompatible change.

key.description: First 16 hex characters of sha256 over the canonical manifest bytes with 'key' omitted. The payload folder is named after it.

tag.description: The version tag the payload was built for, e.g. 'nightly'. Informational.

game_version.description: The Minecraft version, '26.3' today. A payload for another version is not installed.

mod_api_level.description: Must equal the mark horizon_mods::api_level::MARK carries in the entry program; a mismatch is an error.

platform.description: The Rust target triple of every file. A launcher refuses another platform's payload.

entry.description: The game program, one of 'files'. Read by the launcher for mod_api_level and started for Play.

preparer_output_version.description: OUTPUT_VERSION of horizon-prepare (crates/horizon-prepare/src/lib.rs), which decides whether a player's prepared resources still fit.

path.description: Relative, forward slashes, no absolute path, no '..' segment, no drive or scheme colon, unique in 'files'.

exec.description: Executable bit on Unix; ignored on Windows.
